title: Allowances for Brake Work, Tyres and Recall Repairs on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan
content:
Brake work, replacement tyres and recall repairs are carried on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan against allowances set for one term, and against a tread depth at which a tyre is to be replaced. Allowances are in USD and run for one term.

| Plan | Brake work | Brake pad and disc allowance | Tyre replacement allowance | Tread depth at which a tyre is replaced (thirty-seconds of an inch) | Recall work arranged with a franchised dealer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | Not included | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4 | Not arranged |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | Included | 250.00 | 0.00 | 4 | Not arranged |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | Included | 500.00 | 400.00 | 5 | Arranged |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | Included | 700.00 | 700.00 | 5 | Arranged |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | Included | 1200.00 | 1500.00 | 6 | Arranged |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | Included | 400.00 | 900.00 | 6 | Arranged |

### Notes on the allowances

An allowance of 0.00 stands against the plans written without that item: the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan carries no brake work and no tyre allowance, and the Keyturn Care Routine Plan carries brake work but no tyre allowance.

The tread figure is the depth at which a tyre must be replaced. A tyre on a vehicle written on the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan or the Keyturn Care Electric Plan is replaced at 6 thirty-seconds of an inch; on the Keyturn Care Complete Plan or the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan at 5; on the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan or the Keyturn Care Routine Plan at 4.

Recall work is arranged with a franchised dealer on four of the six plans, the two exceptions being the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan and the Keyturn Care Routine Plan.
